title: Open Jam @ Thunderbay Bar
event_description: Join Greg Norris and the house band for an energetic open jam session. Musicians of all skill levels are welcome to bring their instruments and join in on rock blues and classic favorites.
event_venue_information:
About Thunderbay Bar

Winner of Best Neighborhood Bar in Creative Loafing's Best of the Bay 2024 and 2025 Thunderbay Bar is a vibrant local favorite offering great cocktails ice cold beer and live entertainment. The venue features over 16 high-definition TVs making it perfect for sports fans while also hosting a variety of music events throughout the week.

Music Events

Thunderbay hosts open jam sessions on both Monday and Tuesday nights from 5-10 PM where musicians can bring instruments borrow instruments or simply enjoy watching talented local players. The bar also features karaoke dance parties on Wednesday Friday and Saturday nights creating a lively atmosphere for entertainment seekers.

Venue Features

The bar offers outdoor seating pool tables dart boards and corn hole making it a complete entertainment destination. With friendly bartenders and a welcoming community atmosphere Thunderbay has become a cornerstone of Tampa's local music scene.

title: Open Jam @ Pete's Place South
event_description: Weekly open jam session hosted by Shawn Brown. This late-night session welcomes musicians to join the house band for rock blues and classic jam favorites. The venue provides a relaxed neighborhood bar atmosphere.
event_venue_information:
About Pete's Place South

A Tampa institution since 1979 Pete's Place South is a newly renovated neighborhood bar known for the cheapest drink specials in town. The venue features 17 TVs with NFL ticket fresh Gulf grouper and gulf shrimp on the menu and a welcoming atmosphere for locals and visitors alike.

Music and Entertainment

Pete's Place hosts open jam sessions on Tuesday nights and is also known as the best karaoke spot in town with karaoke nights every Thursday Friday and Saturday. The bar features both smoking and non-smoking areas live sports dart boards and a jukebox.

Community Vibe

The venue maintains a strong neighborhood feel with friendly bartenders and a loyal local following. The combination of affordable drinks good food and regular music events has made Pete's Place South a beloved gathering spot in Tampa's music community.

title: Open Mic @ Tom's Tavern Forest Hills
event_description: Weekly open mic night hosted by Fred Chandler featuring acoustic and electric performances. This long-running event welcomes singers songwriters and musicians of all genres in a supportive neighborhood tavern setting.
event_venue_information:
About Tom's Tavern Forest Hills

Tom's Tavern Forest Hills is a quintessential American pub combining a lively atmosphere with quality food and entertainment. Formerly Uncle Fats the venue has maintained its reputation for excellent wings friendly service and community spirit.

Live Music

The tavern hosts open mic night every Wednesday from 7-10 PM which is highly recommended for great music in a safe friendly atmosphere. The venue also features live bands on select Friday and Saturday nights with a dance floor that gets plenty of use.

Food and Atmosphere

Known for having some of the best wings in Tampa Tom's Tavern offers daily specials and a menu featuring burgers fried pickles buffalo wings and other pub favorites. The venue includes pool tables multiple TVs for sports and both indoor and outdoor seating making it family-friendly until 9 PM.

title: Friday Night Jazz @ DI Coffee Bar
event_description: Intimate jazz experience on the back patio of this Davis Islands coffee shop. Hosted by guitarist Dominic Walker this free weekly series features top local and touring jazz musicians performing standards and improvisation.
event_venue_information:
About DI Coffee Bar

DI Coffee Bar is a vibrant community hub on Davis Islands serving Miami-based Panther Coffee and all-day fare including creative Cuban sandwich variations. The venue has become known for its welcoming atmosphere and commitment to live music.

Friday Night Jazz

The Friday Night Jazz series celebrated its second anniversary in October 2025 and has become a beloved institution in Tampa's jazz scene. The intimate back patio setting fills quickly with neighbors and music lovers from across Tampa Bay. There's a five-dollar door charge and the atmosphere is casual and supportive. The house band features Paul Gavin on drums James Suggs on trumpet Bryan Hughes on vocals and Jon Shea on bass with Dominic Walker leading on guitar.

Venue Features

The coffee shop features both indoor seating and a charming back patio with fire pits and space heaters for year-round comfort. In case of rain music moves inside. A second location is planned for Seminole Heights expanding DI Coffee Bar's reach in Tampa's music community.

title: Monday Night Jazz Jam @ The Hangar
event_description: Tampa Bay's authentic jazz jam session featuring New Orleans style jazz and spontaneous collaborations. Hosted by trumpeter Dwayne White with a seasoned house band this free event welcomes musicians of all levels to sit in.
sign_up: In Person - register in advance or day of
event_venue_information:
About The Hangar

Located at the Albert Whitted Airport on St. Petersburg's waterfront The Hangar Restaurant & Flight Lounge offers a unique dining and music experience with views of planes taking off and landing against the Tampa Bay skyline.

Monday Night Jazz Jam

The Monday Night Jazz Jam celebrated its 15th year in 2025 and is presented by the Al Downing Tampa Bay Jazz Association. The free event runs from 7-9 PM and features host Dwayne White on trumpet with the house band including Stretch Bruyn on keyboard Kenny Walker on bass and Ron Gregg on drums. Musicians can register in advance or show up day-of to participate. The jam welcomes everyone from seasoned professionals to high school students creating a supportive environment for jazz education and performance.

Food and Atmosphere

Executive Chef Matthew Smith creates daily specials including burgers meatloaf and pork chops. The restaurant serves breakfast lunch and dinner and features Friday night performances by the Dwayne White Trio in addition to the Monday jam sessions.
